title: Split remaining mixed-responsibility compiler monoliths
body:
Refactor authored production files with multiple independently changing responsibilities into thin explicit facades and focused implementation modules. Preserve one implementation per construct, public paths, generation-bound Salsa authority, TypedProgram-to-ISLE lowering, diagnostic ordering, and fail-closed runtime behavior. Completed splits have static declaration/body/export parity and buildability; remaining targets must receive GitNexus impact review, implementation files under the agreed size threshold, focused Cargo verification after each structurally complete wave, and no compatibility duplicate paths.

**Linear:** [CYB-183](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-183/v04-split-remaining-mixed-responsibility-compiler-monoliths)

subtasks.text: Split community routes, heap, document service, and assembly loader
Split shell host and call-expression lowering
Audit remaining 600+ LOC authored mixed-responsibility files
Run final Cargo and duplicate/LOC/change-impact verification
